svg.text: A clinician's sentences become a typed AppSpec through tools; the platform's compiler turns the spec into the app. The model never writes code, a layout or a data scope.

Guard-rails are in code, not prose: buildable archetypes come from the schema, codes and groups from lookups, the language from a detector — anything the model must get right every time is decided outside the model.
